expected_scenes.title: City Rhythm
expected_scenes.narration: In the heart of every great city, there's a rhythm. A pulse that beats beneath the concrete, beneath the glass towers, beneath the noise.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Aerial view of a sprawling modern city at twilight, glass towers reflecting ambient light, urban energy visible in the streets below

expected_scenes.title: Before Dawn
expected_scenes.narration: It starts before dawn, when the bakers light their ovens and the streets still belong to the cats. The air smells of flour and possibility.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: A baker in a warm-lit bakery pulling fresh bread from a glowing oven, pre-dawn darkness visible through the window, flour dust in the air

expected_scenes.title: Morning Commute
expected_scenes.narration: Then the sun breaks through. Commuters pour from the subway like water finding its level. Coffee cups in hand. Earbuds in. Eyes forward. Each one carrying a universe of plans and worries and small joys.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Commuters emerging from a subway station entrance into morning sunlight, coffee cups in hand, earbuds in, urban morning rush hour

expected_scenes.title: Noon in the Park
expected_scenes.narration: By noon the parks are alive. Children chase pigeons. Old men play chess under the elms. A street musician plays something that sounds like longing wrapped in a minor key.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Sunlit city park at midday, children chasing pigeons on green grass, dappled light through elm trees, vibrant and alive

expected_scenes.title: The Makers
expected_scenes.narration: The afternoon belongs to the makers. In studios and workshops and cramped apartments, people bend metal, write code, mix paint, shape clay. Creating the things that make a city more than just buildings.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: An artist in a sunlit workshop shaping wet clay on a pottery wheel, hands covered in clay, focused expression, creative tools visible around the studio

expected_scenes.title: Golden Hour
expected_scenes.narration: As the golden hour arrives, everything softens. The harsh edges blur. Strangers smile at each other. The city exhales.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: City street bathed in warm golden hour sunlight, long shadows stretching across the pavement, soft warm backlight on pedestrians

expected_scenes.title: City Lights
expected_scenes.narration: And when the lights come on — the neon, the streetlamps, the glow from a thousand apartment windows — the city transforms. It becomes a constellation grounded in asphalt, a galaxy you can walk through.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: City skyline at night with thousands of lit apartment windows, neon signs glowing, streetlamps creating pools of warm light on wet pavement

expected_scenes.title: Your City
expected_scenes.narration: This is the city. Your city. Every day, a new story.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Wide establishing shot of the city at dawn, first light breaking over the skyline, fresh day beginning
